name: dhscanner/frontphp
description: Tiny PHP HTTP front for dhscanner. Wraps nikic/PhpParser behind a single POST endpoint served by PHP's built-in dev server. Deliberately framework-less: no Laravel, no routing library, no CSRF, no sessions. The whole HTTP surface is index.php. Blade templates (*.blade.php) are compiled to plain PHP first, with illuminate/view's BladeCompiler.
